developmentRecords: none: the evaluation split is held out; the library was learned from training programs only
statement: On the ARC-AGI-1 evaluation split, 102 tasks, at 3000 ms per task, 2 workers and 2 attempts per task, arms run one at a time: the grid search with a library learned from 156 solved training tasks (1 macros, a learned search order, run as a portfolio: the hand ordered search for the first 2250 ms, then the learned order with the macros) solved 73, and without it 71 and 71 in 2 runs (run to run noise 0 tasks, 0 tasks flipped between them). Against the better no-library run the margin is 2; against the first no-library run the library newly solved 2 and lost 0. At attempt 1 alone: library 73, no library 71 and 71. Macros used in at least one right answer: 0 of 1. Mean ms per task: library 2087.71, no library 2080.27 and 2075.59; timed out: library 21, no library 23 and 23. The bar (library above the better no-library run by more than the noise) is MET. Latencies were measured on a machine shared with other builders.
